newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume drops as mkt awaits direction.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume drops as mkt awaits direction.

text.p: Traded volume on the Istanbul gold exchange fell to 915 kg on Tuesday from Monday's 1,462 kg as traders were sidelined awaiting market direction, dealers said.
Gold closed lower at $341.00 an ounce and 1,484,000 lira per gram versus $341.50 and 1,489,000 lira on Monday, following easier levels on European markets, dealers said.
The Turkish lira eased slightly to 135,270 lira to the dollar compared to Monday's close of 135,200 amid fears of intervention after the central bank bought lira for dollars over the past three days.
Brokers said there was some physical demand on the market, but uncertainties over the metal's trend in world markets kept volume down.
Most of the day's trade -- 855 kg -- took place in the morning session, with 84.7 percent traded in lira terms.
